summary: getComputedStyle may target a parsed supported pseudo-element while invalid/unsupported pseudo parsing follows CSSOM behavior.

target.notes: Preserve CSSOM/parser/renderer semantics; this is not an ordinary C# dictionary or geometry-field access.

semantics.unsupported_special: ::slotted()/::part() do not yield an ordinary target declaration
semantics.single_colon: legacy CSS2 pseudo spellings may parse

tests.name: normal
tests.expected_behavior: returns a CSSStyleProperties object for the pseudo-element target when applicable

tests.name: edge
tests.expected_behavior: does not fabricate ordinary element style for a pseudo target CSSOM excludes
